Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what information Digital Growth Hub (“we”, “us”) collects when you buy a Freelancer Vault toolkit, how we use it, and how we protect it.

1. Information we collect

  • Name and email address you enter at checkout or in our support form.
  • Order details such as the tier you bought, order ID and purchase date.
  • Payment information is entered only on our secure third-party checkout gateway. We never see or store your card, UPI or bank details.

2. How we use your information

  • To deliver your Access PDF with Google Drive links to your email after purchase.
  • To send order confirmations and, for Ultimate buyers, notices about lifetime updates.
  • To answer support requests and process refund requests.
  • To prevent fraud and unauthorised sharing of paid files.

3. We do not share your data

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information. We share it only with the checkout and payment provider and email or delivery tools needed to complete your order, and only to the extent required. We may also disclose it if the law requires us to.

4. Data security

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards, and limit access to your information to people who need it to serve you. No online system is completely secure, but we work to protect your data.

5. Retention and your rights

We keep order and support records only as long as needed for delivery, support, refunds and legal or accounting obligations. You may ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information by writing to support@digitalgrowthhub.com.

6. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The “last updated” date above shows the latest version. Questions? Contact Support.

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: November 2026

These Terms govern your purchase and use of the digital toolkits sold by Digital Growth Hub, including the Freelancer Vault tiers (Starter, Pro Growth and Ultimate). By purchasing, you agree to them.

1. Digital product and delivery

All products are digital downloads. No physical item is shipped. After payment is confirmed, we send an Access PDF with Google Drive links to the email you used at checkout. Please check your spam folder and make sure your email is correct.

2. Personal, non-transferable licence

On purchase you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the files for your own freelance or business work, including your own client projects. The licence covers one individual only and cannot be sub-licensed.

3. Prohibited use

  • Reselling, redistributing, sharing or giving away the files or Drive links, in whole or in part.
  • Uploading them to marketplaces, groups, channels, cloud folders or file-sharing sites.
  • Repackaging them into your own course, bundle or product for sale.
  • Claiming the original templates as your own product.

Breach may lead to withdrawal of access without refund and legal action.

4. Updates

Ultimate Vault includes lifetime updates, meaning updates for as long as the product is offered. Content may be improved, reorganised or replaced over time.

5. No guarantee of results

The toolkits are educational and productivity resources. We do not guarantee any income, number of clients or business outcome, which depend on your effort, niche and execution. Contract and agreement templates are general samples, not legal advice. Please have them reviewed by a qualified professional before relying on them.

6. Liability and law

To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the product. These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Refunds are covered in our Refund Policy.

7. Contact
